item.name: 11. Legal Content CMS (SET-12)
item.description: Dedicated Privacy Policy / Terms content. CmsContent policy (SuperAdmin or ContentAdmin with a Normal token). Draft -> Published -> Archived; publishing archives the previous version and retains all history; nothing is deleted. Write requests are manual authoring examples with PLACEHOLDER values only - do not run them as automated happy paths.

item.name: List legal documents (Admin)
item.description: 200 with every matching version (Draft, Published, Archived), newest version first within each (documentType, audience) pair. Optional filters: ?documentType=1|2, ?audience=1..4, ?status=1|2|3.

item.name: Get legal document version (Admin)
item.description: 200 with the full LegalDocumentResponse including ordered bilingual sections. Unknown id -> 404 Cms.Legal.NotFound. Uses legalDocumentId captured by the list request or set manually.

item.name: Create Privacy Policy draft (manual)
item.description: 201 Draft with server-assigned version = max(versions for this type+audience) + 1. Privacy policies MUST contain exactly one UserRights section with at least one Arabic and one English bullet; replace PLACEHOLDER_* values before sending. Second draft for the same pair -> 409 Cms.Legal.DraftAlreadyExists.

item.name: Create Terms draft (manual)
item.description: 201 Draft. Terms MUST NOT contain a UserRights section (409 Cms.Legal.InvalidOperation / validation failure otherwise).

item.name: Update draft sections (manual)
item.description: Full replacement of the section list; Draft only. Published/Archived versions are immutable -> 409 Cms.Legal.PublishedDocumentImmutable. 200 returns the full updated version.

item.name: Publish draft (manual)
item.description: One transaction: the previous Published version of the same (type, audience) becomes Archived, this Draft becomes Published with publishedOnUtc set. Exactly one Published version per pair remains. Re-publishing a Published version is an idempotent 200 success; publishing an Archived one -> 409 Cms.Legal.InvalidOperation.

item.name: 12. Help Center CMS (SET-13)
item.description: FAQ management per app audience plus the ONE global support contact pair. CmsContent policy (SuperAdmin or ContentAdmin with a Normal token). FAQs are not versioned; deactivation hides them from apps - there is no delete route. Contact-card data only: no SMS, no email sending, no notification behavior. Write requests are manual authoring examples with PLACEHOLDER values only.

item.name: List FAQs (Admin)
item.description: 200 with active AND inactive records when no filter is given. Optional numeric filters: ?audience=1..4, ?isActive=true|false.

item.name: Get FAQ (Admin)
item.description: 200 with the full bilingual record. Unknown id -> 404 Cms.Help.FaqNotFound.

item.name: Create FAQ (manual)
item.description: 201 with the created HelpFaqResponse. All four question/answer fields are required in both languages; audience is 1..4 (app types only).

item.name: Update FAQ (manual)
item.description: Full replace of question/answer/audience/displayOrder/isActive. 200 with the updated record.

item.name: Activate FAQ (manual)
item.description: 200, idempotent. Apps only ever see active FAQs for their own audience (derived from the JWT).

item.name: Deactivate FAQ (manual)
item.description: 200, idempotent. Hidden from app reads; the record is retained.

item.name: Get support contact (Admin)
item.description: 200 with the single global pair, or 404 Cms.Help.SupportContactNotFound when nothing has been configured yet.

item.name: Upsert support contact (manual)
item.description: Upserts THE one global row (phone must be E.164, e.g. +201000000001; email must be valid). 200 with the stored pair. Not per-role; sends nothing.

item.name: 12. Subscription plan configuration (manual)
item.description: Super Admin only. Plan authoring, publication, and retirement are configuration mutations; use owner-approved plan fixtures and do not replay against shared data without authorization.

item.name: List family subscriptions (safe read)
item.description: Safe read. Returns paged family subscription snapshots, family context, owner ID, stored plan terms, current-state, auto-renew, cancellation, and period-end fields. Includes historical non-current snapshots.

item.name: Get family subscription (safe read)
item.description: Safe read. Returns one stored family subscription snapshot; unknown IDs return 404 Subscriptions.Subscription.NotFound.

item.name: List subscription plans (safe read)
item.description: Safe read. Returns all draft, published, and retired-for-new-sales plan versions so administrators can see the complete catalog state.

item.name: Get subscription plan (safe read)
item.description: Safe read. Returns one plan version with immutable terms, benefits, publication state, availability, and timestamps; unknown IDs return 404 Subscriptions.Plan.NotFound.

item.name: Create subscription plan draft (manual)

body.raw:
{
  "key": "premium",
  "version": 2,
  "price": 299.00,
  "cycle": 1,
  "currency": "EGP",
  "benefits": [
    { "key": 1, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 2, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 3, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 4, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 5, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 6, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 7, "isIncluded": true },
    { "key": 8, "isIncluded": false }
  ],
  "memberLimit": { "kind": 1, "value": 10 },
  "monthlyBookingLimit": { "kind": 1, "value": 20 },
  "rollover": 1,
  "paymobSubscriptionPlanId": 6755

item.description: Manual example only. Create creates a draft only; publish separately with the publish request. No plan edit endpoint exists, and family subscriptions activate only after a successful payment callback is settled. The request must include all eight benefit keys exactly once with boolean isIncluded. Numeric enums: cycle 1=Monthly/2=Annual; benefit key 1=Chatting, 2=Library, 3=CommunityForum, 4=FamilyActivityTimeline, 5=BasicSearch, 6=AdvancedSearchFilters, 7=MedicalSummaryExportAndSecureSharing, 8=PremiumContent; limit kind 1=Finite (positive value)/2=Unlimited (null value); rollover 1=None/2=NotApplicable. Optional paymobSubscriptionPlanId enables initial Card enrollment when Paymob Card 3DS is configured; it is not a provider subscription ID. Success is 201 with the draft plan-version UUID. Duplicate key/version is 409 Subscriptions.Plan.DuplicateVersion.

item.name: Publish subscription plan (manual)
item.description: Manual mutation. Success is 204; missing plan is 404 Subscriptions.Plan.NotFound; already published or publication race is 409. Published terms are immutable.

item.name: Retire subscription plan (manual)
item.description: Manual mutation. Success is 204 and appends an immutable audit record; missing is 404; unpublished or already retired is 409. Existing subscription snapshots are unchanged.

item.name: 13. Subscription Coupons (manual configuration)
item.description: Super Admin only. Read requests are safe; create and delete mutate configuration and require an owner-approved fixture. This folder does not redeem coupons or call Paymob.

item.name: Create coupon (manual)
item.description: Manual/destructive configuration call. Requires a normal Super Admin JWT and a published available plan UUID. Success: 201 with coupon UUID. Errors: 400 Subscriptions.Coupon.Invalid, 404 Subscriptions.Coupon.PlanNotFound, 409 Subscriptions.Coupon.DuplicateCode. The code is normalized to uppercase; do not replay unchanged against shared data.

item.name: List coupons
item.description: Safe read. Returns 200 with coupons ordered by code. Requires a normal Super Admin JWT.

item.name: Coupon detail
item.description: Safe read. Returns 200 with id, code, planVersionId, discountPercentage, expiresOnUtc, and createdOnUtc; unknown UUID returns 404 Subscriptions.Coupon.NotFound.

item.name: Delete coupon (manual)
item.description: Manual/destructive hard delete. Requires a normal Super Admin JWT. Success: 204; unknown UUID: 404 Subscriptions.Coupon.NotFound. Deletion does not implement redemption or rewrite transactions.

item.description: Manual/stateful sensitive read. Optional startDate, endDate, and dependentId filters. Returns counts and adherenceRate from persisted dose logs only; no scheduled rows are synthesized. A successful GET writes an immutable audit row. No request body.

Returns 201 when created; malformed sectionsJson returns 400; missing/empty file returns 400 Storage.File.Empty; unsupported/mismatched image content returns 400 Storage.File.UnsupportedType; invalid domain content returns 409 Cms.WellnessTip.InvalidOperation. The embedded sectionsJson property names are case-sensitive: use DisplayOrder, ArabicText, EnglishText. Only drafts can be edited. Omit file to keep the existing image; supplying one replaces the image key.

The evaluate POST has an action-level ElderlyMedicationOperationalManage override on the read controller (Normal SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin). The CMS GET is read-only; both POSTs can change state and are manual disposable-fixture requests.

Creates and activates the next immutable revision, deactivating the previous active revision; only one revision remains active. thresholdMinutes must be 1–1440; invalid values return 400 Cms.MedicationLateness.Invalid. Success returns revisionId, version, thresholdMinutes, isActive, and createdOnUtc. Do not replay without owner-approved disposable CMS data.

request.description: STATE-CHANGING: the action-level policy override is ElderlyMedicationOperationalManage (Normal SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin), despite the controller's class-level ElderlyMedicationOperationalRead policy. The action audits before resolving the target; a missing Elderly or Elderly linked to a deleted Family returns 404 Families.AdminMedication.NotFound. On success it evaluates only the selected profile's current IANA-local day using the active versioned CMS threshold, returns thresholdMinutes/settingVersion/localDate/missedDoses, and may persist current-day scheduled/missed dose logs plus idempotent durable in-app alerts. Assigned caregivers qualify only for active Confirmed/InProgress bookings; active linked Family recipients must honor MedicationReminders; active SupportAdmin users are included. Push/email/outbox/scheduler are deferred/Needs Owner Verification. Use only an approved disposable fixture.

item.name: 15C. Sentence-builder CMS (manual authoring/read-only)
item.description: Normal SuperAdmin or ContentAdmin under CmsContent. CMS is global/shared. GETs are safe; create and activate/deactivate change catalog state and are manual authoring examples only. Successful catalog routes return 200 OK. Unauthenticated requests return 401; authenticated roles outside CmsContent return 403; missing revisions return 404 Cms.SentenceBuilder.NotFound; invalid category, blank/overlong key or labels, and negative display order return 409 Cms.SentenceBuilder.InvalidOperation. Persistence concurrency conflicts are 409 Cms.SentenceBuilder.Conflict.

request.description: Read-only. Success returns 200. Categories: Actor=1, Action=2, Need=3, Qualifier=4. Page size is bounded 1–100; results include immutable revisions and active state. Unauthenticated returns 401; roles outside CmsContent return 403.
Read-only bilingual revision detail. Success returns 200; unauthenticated returns 401; roles outside CmsContent return 403; an absent revision returns 404 Cms.SentenceBuilder.NotFound.

STATE-CHANGING authoring example. Success returns 200. Labels are required, bilingual, max 200 chars; stableKey max 120 chars; displayOrder is nonnegative. Invalid category, blank/overlong key or labels, or negative order returns 409 Cms.SentenceBuilder.InvalidOperation; a persistence concurrency conflict returns 409 Cms.SentenceBuilder.Conflict. Upsert creates a new immutable revision and activates it while deactivating the prior revision for the same stable key/category. Unauthenticated returns 401 and roles outside CmsContent return 403. Do not run without owner-approved disposable CMS fixture data.

STATE-CHANGING authoring example. Success returns 200. request.description: Returns checked-out paid/refunded bookings, remaining payable, effective Finance payout-fee rate, net amount, recorded transfer metadata, and outstanding facility debt. An eligible payable requires an effective Finance rule; absent configuration fails closed.
